rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: RNWY provides explainable trust intelligence for AI agents and crypto wallets, covering 150,000+ agents across EVM and Solana ecosystems. It detects Sybil manipulation, analyzes reviewer wallets for coordinated fraud patterns, and issues cryptographically signed attestations (ERC-8004 soulbound tokens) that persist on-chain. The service is free without an API key and supports eight MCP tools including trust checks, reviewer analysis, agent comparison, and on-chain address age lookups.
